principle: selected_reads is a LOGICAL reader-invocation-scope account. It is truthfully satisfiable by a projection-configured read, PROVIDED the run never claims physical byte suppression and never presents the account as evidence that unselected columns went unread.

rules.rule: selected_reads = 1 requires exactly one reader invocation issued with an explicit selected-column scope equal to the bound variable set.
rules.enforcement: Column names AND ordinals are validated against the real column inventory BEFORE any row-data read.

rules.rule: A missing or empty selection is a fail-closed STOP raised BEFORE any row-data read.
If the reader returns any column outside the bound set, that is UNEXPECTED_SELECTED_COLUMN and is a STOP.
rules.enforcement: Post-read assertion on the returned column set.

rules.rule: full_reads = 0 is enforced by REFUSING any row-data invocation that carries no selected-column scope, before it executes.
rules.enforcement: A pinned zero ceiling on the full-read counter, refused pre-operation.

rules.rule: The physical read calls and bytes consumed by the single selected invocation are recorded ONLY in byte_counts_where_measurable / reader read-call accounts, at the broker layer, and are never folded into selected_reads.
rules.enforcement: Distinct counters, as the candidate already implements.

rules.rule: The run MUST carry a machine-readable non-suppression disclosure, and a court MUST assert its presence so it cannot be quietly dropped.
rules.enforcement: The candidate already emits selected_route_physical_column_suppression = NOT_ENFORCED_BY_READER (d5ce4ecff6acc25d199577a7859de7e98514e9fd) and asserts the disclosure in court C9c.

rules.rule: selected_reads must never be presented, in any receipt or summary, as evidence that unselected columns went unread.
rules.enforcement: Disclosure discipline; a violation is a truthfulness failure, not a variance.

rules.rule: Path opens remain a separate account and are unaffected by the selection.

what_this_rule_does_NOT_buy: It does not reduce physical I/O. Bytes consumed are unchanged from an unfiltered read.
It does not close R9-SEL-03 by itself; the selected route must still be implemented and requalified.
It does not bind any currently-unbound numeric account. byte_counts remains UNBOUND.
It confers no semantic authority. The semantic ceilings are unchanged.
honest_weakness_of_this_rule: R1-R4 are satisfiable by a projection, so full_reads=0 constrains invocation SCOPE rather than physical behaviour. A reviewer who believes the frozen ceiling was meant to bound physical I/O would reject this rule. That is precisely the residual addressed in 07_LIMITS_AND_RESIDUAL_AMBIGUITY.json.

candidate_conformance.evidence: 00_RETURN.md: usecols with names and ordinals bound against the real column inventory before any row-data read; every carrier selected_reads=1, full_reads=0; missing selection -> DecoderError before any row read; reader injecting an unselected column -> UNEXPECTED_SELECTED_COLUMN; full read refused before it executes; non-suppression disclosure asserted in court C9c.
